name: Read the Wound
text: You have studied where bodies fail the way a smith studies where iron cracks. Whenever you deal damage to an enemy with an Agility attack, you learn whether it is unhurt, wounded, or near death, and you learn which of its Defense Ratings is lowest. For the rest of that combat, your Agility attacks against that enemy resolve against the lower of its Vigor Defense and Agility Defense.

name: From the Dark
text: Nothing done in the open is worth what one unseen moment is worth. The first time each round that you deal damage to an enemy while you are Hidden, while you have Cover, or before that enemy has acted this combat, you gain 1 Momentum.

name: Arterial Precision
text: You cut where the blood is already moving. Whenever a die in your Impact Roll Explodes, the target begins Bleeding. If it is already Bleeding from your strikes, that Bleed deals 2 additional True Damage each turn instead, to a maximum of 6.

name: Pressure Point
text: You put the blade where the body gives, not where it is thickest. When you deal damage to an enemy with a Finesse or ranged attack, spend 1 Momentum to choose one effect: it Downgrades its next Impact Die, it cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn, or it must succeed on a Vigor Save or be knocked Prone.

name: Ghost Step
text: The position was already wrong; you simply leave it before the consequence lands. As a Reaction when you take damage from an attack against your Agility Defense or from an area effect, spend 1 Momentum and 1 Agility Point, roll your Agility Die, and reduce that damage by the result. You then move up to 10ft without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and if that movement ends in Cover or concealment you become Hidden.

name: Slip Away
text: You are trained not to be where the enemy swings. For 1 AP and 1 Momentum, move up to 15ft without provoking Opportunity Attacks. If that movement ends within reach of cover, darkness, or anything else that could plausibly conceal you, you become Hidden; if it ends adjacent to an enemy, add one Agility Die to the first Impact Roll you make against that enemy this turn.

name: Targeting Shot
text: You place the shot to open a door rather than to close one. When you deal damage to an enemy with a ranged Agility attack, spend 1 Momentum to Mark it until the end of your next turn. Your allies' Impact Rolls against the Marked target treat its Vigor Defense and Agility Defense as Sundered by 1.

name: Executioner's Strike
text: Requires any two Shadow Majors. There is a point on every body where the argument is already settled, and you have been looking at it since the fight began. For 1 AP, 2 Momentum, and 2 Agility Points, make one Agility attack and do not roll its first Impact Die: it counts as having rolled its maximum face, and it Explodes once. That bonus die does not Explode again.

name: The Final Cut
text: You arrive at the end of a process you began before the fight did. Once per combat, spend 2 Agility Points and make one Agility attack. Every die in that Impact Roll Explodes, and the target begins Bleeding. Every Sunder you have placed on that target becomes permanent for the remainder of combat.
